decisions.reason: Replacing the fiat on-ramp provider does not change Brevo as the transactional email provider.
The provider replacement does not change SIWE or the wallet-authenticated mint and transfer flows.
The fiat provider changes, but magic-link authentication and dashboard access for non-wallet users remain unchanged.
The on-ramp provider replacement does not alter the amount or automatic distribution of referral commissions.
The source changes only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not alter coded-referral ticket issuance.
The source does not change ticket allocation for mints made without a referral code.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not affect unauthenticated access to public APIs.
The payment-provider substitution has no necessary effect on Chainlink VRF winner selection.
The fiat on-ramp provider replacement does not change the required NFT metadata counters or badges.
The payment-provider change does not alter enforcement of secondary-sale royalties.
